subject: EU-only processing: SCCs, KMS & deletion evidentiary ask
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@medeuropa.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Anton Müller <a.mueller@medeuropa.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 09:12:00 +0200
Subject: EU-only processing: SCCs, KMS & deletion evidentiary ask

Hi Aditya,

Thanks for taking the call today. As discussed, MedEuropa has a strict requirement that any processing of EU personal data for this contract stays within EU jurisdictions only. Our legal team has attached a short questionnaire focused on Schrems II / SCCs, key management, and deletion proof for customer data. A few specific asks:

- Can you confirm that all production inference and persistent storage for our workload can be restricted to AWS eu-west-1/eu-west-2 or GCP europe-west?
- Do you support BYOK/HSM-backed keys so that customer keys never leave EU control?
- For deletion requests, we need a documented evidence artifact showing deletion from primary store and backups within the agreed retention window.
- Which subprocessors (if any) would potentially see EU personal data and where are they located?

Attached: MedEuropa_SCCs_AnnexA_questions.pdf

We'd like concise technical answers so our legal team can complete the vendor review this week. Can you loop in the appropriate folks?

Best,
Elena

--
Elena Rossi
Head of Procurement, MedEuropa
elena.rossi@medeuropa.com
+39 06 555 0123

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 11:03:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: EU-only processing: SCCs, KMS & deletion evidentiary ask

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Laura (product) and Rishi (security) so we can provide specific confirmations and the evidence package.

Quick note while we assemble: Redwood supports regional routing and can pin inference and persistent artifacts (logs, embeddings) to EU regions. We also offer an optional Private deployment (VPC) where control plane signals can be managed through a customer-controlled endpoint.

Laura/Rishi — can you confirm the following for MedEuropa's deal:
1) Which regions we can commit to for production and backups (eu-west-1 / europe-west-2 etc.)?
2) KMS options: is BYOK via KMS/HSM possible for Private and Dedicated customers, and can key material be kept in EU KMS?
3) Deletion evidence: what artifacts can we provide (DB deletion log, backup purge audit, retention ledger)?
4) Subprocessor list and locations — anything outside EU that might be in scope?

I'll keep Elena posted as we have concrete answers.

Thanks,
Aditya

--
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai

From: laura.bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2027 10:27:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: EU-only processing: SCCs, KMS & deletion evidentiary ask

Aditya — details below (technical summary for MedEuropa):

1) Regions: For hosted and dedicated offerings we can commit to eu-west-1 and europe-west2 (GCP) for all inference, embedding storage, logs, and persistent metadata. Backups are kept within the same region for the configured retention window (we do not geo-replicate outside chosen region unless explicitly enabled).

2) KMS/BYOK:
- Dedicated & Private: support for customer-managed keys (BYOK) using standard KMS integrations (AWS KMS with imported key material or external HSM integration). Keys can be provisioned in EU KMS regions; our control plane does not retain key material.
- Hosted: we offer envelope encryption with provider-managed keys by default; however, for enterprise plans we can enable a dedicated KMS envelope with customer-provided keys scoped to EU KMS.

3) Deletion evidence: We can provide a multi-artifact deletion package that includes:
- Primary store deletion log (timestamped row-level deletes)
- Backup purge audit (snapshot deletion records and retention truncation for that snapshot range)
- Retention policy ledger entry (policy id and applied timestamps)
- Optional notarized hash of deletion operation for legal teams (PDF).

4) Subprocessors: Current subprocessors that may process telemetry or infra-level logs are listed in the attached subprocessors doc. For the EU-only deployment we can exclude non-EU analytics pipelines and restrict subprocessors to EU-based partners; any non-EU subprocessors would be for optional non-prod tooling only and can be disabled in the contract.

I'll prepare the artifacts and a short tech appendix for legal. Rishi, can you add the KMS/HSM implementation note and retention purge SLA?

Thanks,
Laura

--
Laura Bennett
Product Security, Redwood Inference

From: rishi.malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Cc: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2027 15:10:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: EU-only processing: SCCs, KMS & deletion evidentiary ask

Laura/Aditya — technical confirmations from security side:

- KMS details: For Dedicated/Private we support importing customer keys into AWS KMS (imported key material) and can also integrate with on-prem HSM via PKCS#11 for Private deployments. We do not export key material from EU KMS regions. Automatic key rotation can be customer-controlled; rotation events are recorded in the key-change audit log.

- SCCs / Transfer guards: We ship a DPA that incorporates EU SCCs (2021 standard text) and an annex describing routing & subprocessor restrictions. For extra contractual assurances we can add an audit clause for annual third-party audit (SOC2 + EU-focused checklist).

- Deletion SLA: Standard enterprise SLA for deletion is 30 days for full purge from primary + backup purge window documented; for MedEuropa we can commit to 14 days with an audit artifact (snapshot history + purge logs). Note: immutable cold backups may require the 14-day window to be reflected in the retention ledger — we will include purge confirmation once the snapshot rotation completes.

- Evidence artifacts: We'll produce a single zip containing the deletion ledger, db deletion logs, backup snapshot deletions, and an engineer-signed affidavit. We can timestamp and provide a hashed manifest for cross-checking.

I'll draft a short appendix describing how customer data flows inside EU and the technical controls. Hannah — can you pull the current subprocessors list scoped to EU-only mode and redact anything not relevant?

-Rishi

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@medeuropa.com>
Cc: Anton Müller <a.mueller@medeuropa.com>, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 21 Aug 2027 15:45:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: EU-only processing: SCCs, KMS & deletion evidentiary ask

Hi Elena and Anton — thanks for your patience. Per our internal review (summary below) and attached artifacts, we can meet MedEuropa's EU-only processing requirement under the following commitments:

- Region commitment: Production inference, embeddings, logs, and backups will be constrained to eu-west-1 or europe-west2 (your choice). We will not geo-replicate outside EU unless you provide written approval.

- KMS/BYOK: For Dedicated or Private deployments you can provide/import keys into EU KMS; Redwood will not retain key material. For Hosted enterprise plans we will enable a dedicated envelope using EU KMS where key material is scoped to EU.

- Subprocessors: We will limit subprocessors to EU-based partners for the MedEuropa contracted environment. Non-EU subprocessors for optional tooling will be disabled. The subprocessors list (redacted) is attached.

- Deletion & evidence: We commit to a 14-day purge SLA for MedEuropa with an evidence package delivered on completion that contains deletion logs, backup snapshot purge records, retention ledger, and a signed affidavit. We will also provide a hashed manifest you can store as proof.

Next steps we propose:
1) Please confirm preferred EU region (eu-west-1 or europe-west2).
2) Sign the attached DPA (DocuSign link) which includes SCCs and the annex for regional controls.
3) After signature, we will run a short pilot (2 weeks) to validate key provisioning & deletion flows and deliver the first evidence package.

Attachments: redwood_eu_dataflow_v2.png, kms_key_rotation_summary.pdf, MedEuropa_SCCs_AnnexA_questions.pdf

If you want a technical call with Rishi and Laura to walk through the appendix before signing, we can schedule early next week.

Best,
Aditya
